about: Sturgeon County is a municipal district in Alberta immediately north of Edmonton, surrounding—but separate from—cities and towns such as St. Albert and Morinville on its edges. Hamlets, farms, and industrial lands sit along Highway 2 and the Sturgeon River country. It is a rural municipality in the Capital Region, not a city. About 20,000 people live in Sturgeon County.
